% Adapted from the TeX Live 2025 pgfgantt manual linked-element example.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfgantt}
\begin{document}
\begin{ganttchart}[
  x unit=0.5cm,
  y unit title=0.55cm,
  y unit chart=0.7cm,
  hgrid,
  vgrid,
  link/.append style={red, very thick}
]{1}{10}
  \gantttitle{Linked delivery plan}{10} \\
  \ganttbar{Design}{1}{2} \\
  \ganttlinkedbar{Build}{4}{6} \\
  \ganttlinkedmilestone{Release}{7} \\
  \ganttlinkedbar{Follow-up}{8}{10}
\end{ganttchart}
\end{document}
